title: Tiny, cute planet with rings
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Ring back half -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='42' ry='12' fill='none' stroke='#FFD966' stroke-width='6' transform='rotate(-20 50 52)'/>
  <!-- Planet body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='24' fill='#7B68EE'/>
  <!-- Planet shading -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='42' rx='14' ry='10' fill='#9B8AFF' transform='rotate(-30 42 42)'/>
  <!-- Planet highlight -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='40' r='6' fill='#B8AAFF'/>
  <!-- Planet surface bands -->
  <path d='M28 48 Q50 42 72 48' stroke='#6A55D6' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M27 56 Q50 50 73 56' stroke='#6A55D6' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Cute face -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='46' rx='3.5' ry='4.5' fill='#2E1F6E'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='46' rx='3.5' ry='4.5' fill='#2E1F6E'/>
  <!-- Eye sparkles -->
  <circle cx='44.5' cy='44' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='58.5' cy='44' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M45 54 Q50 59 55 54' stroke='#2E1F6E' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='52' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#FF7BAC' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='52' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#FF7BAC' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Ring front half -->
  <path d='M10 48 Q50 70 90 48' fill='none' stroke='#FFE599' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Ring sparkle -->
  <circle cx='82' cy='54' r='2.5' fill='#FFF2B2'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='50' r='2' fill='#FFF2B2'/>
</svg>
